Wedding Car Rental — FAQ

We offer Sedan, SUV, Innova Crysta, Innova Hycross, Fortuner, Honda City with Sunroof, Verna, BMW, Audi, Jaguar, and Mercedes for weddings in Lucknow. All vehicles come with professional chauffeurs.
Wedding car rental starts at ₹7,500 (all-inclusive local) for a Sedan. Premium options: BMW/Audi/Jaguar at ₹30,000 and Mercedes at ₹35,000.
Yes, all wedding car packages include standard floral decoration. Premium decoration with designer themes can be arranged at additional cost. Contact us to discuss your preferences.
Yes, outstation wedding car bookings are available. Rates start at ₹12/km for sedan with a minimum of 250 km/day. Toll, parking and border tax are charged at actuals.
Yes, a ₹500 night charge applies for travel before 6:30 AM or after 9:30 PM. Waiting charge is also ₹500. These are one-time charges per booking.
